summary: Iter 5: Verified two bug fixes -- (1) WebRTC transceivers use recvonly (both video and audio) in LisaAvatar.jsx, and (2) Foundry integration is migrated to the NEW Azure AI Foundry agent API: create-run body sends {'agent_id': FOUNDRY_AGENT_ID} (no 'assistant_id' anywhere), foundry_base() returns f'{FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT}/api/projects/{FOUNDRY_PROJECT}', and legacy FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT is removed. Env reads for FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT/FOUNDRY_PROJECT/FOUNDRY_AGENT_ID/FOUNDRY_AGENT_VERSION/FOUNDRY_API_KEY confirmed. Backend pytest: 15/15 pass (config unconfigured -> 503 on /avatar/chat and /avatar/credentials, orders+items search regression intact with total=1000 & filters). Frontend: Lisa popup opens with all expected testids, 'show delivered orders' filters to 186, 'go to Items Search' navigates to /items, 'read the top order' reads Order ORD-100170 correctly, 'what is the weather' returns graceful Foundry-503 message ('The Foundry agent isn't configured yet...'), 'reset filters' restores 1,000 records. No crashes. Live avatar video path cannot be end-to-end tested (Azure Speech intentionally unconfigured) but recvonly transceivers verified by code inspection.
frontend_flows_verified: popup contains lisa-video, lisa-transcript, lisa-text-input, lisa-send-btn, lisa-hints, lisa-autointerrupt-checkbox
'go to Items Search' navigates to item-search-page
'read the top order' -> 'Order ORD-100170 for James Smith. Status Delivered, High priority, paid. Amount 4727 dollars, region Europe.'
'what is the weather' -> graceful 'The Foundry agent isn't configured yet...' (503 from new agent_id path, no crash)
'reset filters' -> 'Cleared all filters on Order Search. That's 1,000 matching orders.'
critical_code_review_comments: backend/tests/backend_test.py line 6 contains a hardcoded fallback URL as second arg to os.environ.get -- system prompt asks to avoid defaults. Non-blocking as REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is set, but ideally remove the default so missing config fails fast.

LisaAvatar.jsx video element sets muted; audio track is delivered on a separate <audio> element (correct). Since <video> is muted and audio is separate, this is intentional and works. Just noting for future reviewers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two bug fixes verified. Live Azure paths (Speech token relay, real Foundry agent run) cannot be exercised here because Azure creds are intentionally empty; when the user configures FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT/PROJECT/AGENT_ID + FOUNDRY_API_KEY (or AAD triplet), the create-run path will POST agent_id to {ENDPOINT}/api/projects/{PROJECT}/threads/{tid}/runs?api-version=v1. Same for WebRTC recvonly -- correctness of the fix is code-level; a real Azure Speech key is required to see video on screen.
